description: Create follow-on KainBain tasks (tickets) into a chosen project/pipeline/stage via the KainBain API. Use when findings should become actionable work items.

kbApiBase.description: KainBain API base URL the stage agent should call (default; override with KAINBAIN_API_BASE where different).

targetProject.description: Name (or slug) of the project that receives the new tickets. Defaults to the current project. Accepts a project id, name, or slug; the stage editor offers a dropdown of known projects.

targetWorkflow.description: Workflow (pipeline) id that receives the new tickets. Accepts a workflow id or name (e.g. wf-default / Feature Pipeline); the stage editor offers a dropdown of the target project's workflows.

targetStage.description: Stage (id or exact name) where new tickets land. Case-insensitive name matching is supported by POST /tasks. Accepts a stage id or name; the stage editor offers a dropdown of the target workflow's stages.

context: You may create follow-on KainBain tasks for verified findings using the KainBain API. Follow the skill exactly: resolve ids, dedupe, cap at 10 tickets, and never target the currently executing stage.
